The parent component is re-rendering (due to its own state/props changes), and React re-renders child components by default—even if their props are the same. Wrap your child with `React.memo()` to skip re-renders when props are shallowly equal, but if you're passing new object/array/function references each render, those will still trigger re-renders; use `useMemo()` and `useCallback()` in the parent to memoize those props.
